projects.name: Ellendale HPC campus
projects.quote: We have entered into exclusivity and executed an LOI with a US-based hyperscaler for a 400 MW capacity lease of our Ellendale HPC campus.

projects.name: Ellendale 100 MW HPC facility
projects.quote: During the fiscal second quarter, the Company broke ground on its first 100 MW high-performance compute facility in Ellendale, North Dakota.

projects.name: Jamestown, North Dakota facility
projects.quote: The Company’s 100 MW facility in Jamestown, North Dakota, operated at full capacity during the quarter ended February 29, 2024; however, the Company’s 180 MW facility in Ellendale, North Dakota experienced a power outage starting in January.
